evals.name: create-bind-activate-loop
evals.prompt: warehouse/pick-route 기획은 이미 있어. src/pick.ts의 computePickRoute 함수 계약을 spec 카드로 만들고, 코드에 바인딩해서 활성화까지 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Spec card under warehouse/pick-route with all 4 required arrays (>=1 each), derives pointing at real brief goals (warehouse/pick-route#G-001) and case_of at S-F-01. The full binding loop executed in order: /** @spec <key> */ added to computePickRoute in src/pick.ts, `ed spec sync`, then set-status active succeeds. validate total 0, stderr quiet.

evals.name: fix-broken-derives
evals.prompt: ed validate cards 돌리면 ledger/close-month/run에서 broken-derives가 떠. 원인 보고 제대로 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that PRE-001.derives points at nonexistent G-999 (target-existence is validate-time, not activation-time). Fixes it to the real goal (ledger/close-month#G-001) in place via read-modify-write (all 4 arrays resent). validate total 0 afterward; card stays active.

evals.name: add-shape-with-reference
evals.prompt: warehouse/pick-route/compute spec에 출력 형태를 SHP shape로 선언하고, POST-001이 그 shape를 참조하게 바꿔줘. 나머지는 건드리지 마.
evals.expected_output: A shapes[] entry added (SHP id, role output, schema describing PickStep[] form) and POST-001.references set to that SHP id. All other entries byte-preserved; the optional array added without dropping required ones (read-modify-write, whole namespace). validate total 0 (a wrong ref would be broken-shape-ref).

evals.name: activate-unbound-trap
evals.prompt: geo/route-eta/estimate spec 이제 내용 확정됐으니 active로 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: Activation is rejected: the code index is non-empty (src/eta.ts) but the card has no @spec binding. Correct resolution: add /** @spec geo/route-eta/estimate */ to estimateEta in src/eta.ts, run `ed spec sync`, then activate — not hand-editing status in the file or giving up. Final validate total 0, card active with a resolved binding.
